LBY.note: Fibre reaches the Egyptian border; no domestic backbone between capital and regions stated.

TCD.note: No route stated in service; link to Libya is not yet complete.

facts.fact: A project official said the fibre link from Libya to the Chadian border should be completed by end 2026, with the connection with Chad already engaged with Chadian authorities and telecom firms (Le N'Djam Post).
